gloss: to load (cargo); to publish; to post

definitions.explanation: To place cargo, freight, or goods onto a vehicle, vessel, or surface for transport.

definitions.gloss: to publish; to print; to post; to carry (an article)
definitions.explanation: To include text, an image, an article, or information in a publication, on a website, or in another medium.

examples.japanese: ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{載|の}せた。
examples.english: I loaded the cargo onto the truck.

examples.english: Large quantities of oil are loaded onto ships for transport.

notes:
Kanji variant of ⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧. Use {載|の}せる when the action is about loading cargo for transport or publishing/posting content; use ⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧ for putting people in vehicles or placing things on surfaces in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{載|の}せる: to print in a newspaper
- ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{載|の}せる: to publish in a magazine
- ⟦ホームページ→ホームページ：05869_hoomupeeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{載|の}せる: to post on a website
- ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{載|の}せる: to load onto a ship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧: to put on; to give a ride — general placement, not cargo or publishing
- ⟦{掲載|けいさい}する→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧: to publish; to carry — more formal, used for official publications
